* Updated: Oct. 15, 2024, 4:24 p.m.
* Published: Oct. 24, 2020, 12:42 p.m.

In fact, Democratic presidential candidate former Vice President Joe Biden said transgender children should not experience discrimination. (AP Photo/Morry Gash, Pool)AP

By 

* The Associated Press

Some of the most popular but completely untrue stories and visuals of the week. The Associated Press checked out widely shared but bogus stories on social media. Here are the facts:

Biden said transgender children should not experience discrimination, but he did not say they “have a right to transition.”

At the town hall, Pennsylvania voter Mieke Haeck asked Biden how he would reverse actions by the Trump administration that had negatively affected LGBTQ people, including her 8-year-old transgender daughter.

Biden responded, “I will flat out just change the law. Every — eliminate those executive orders, number one.” He added, “The idea that an 8-year-old child or a 10-year-old child decides, ‘You know I decided I want to be transgender. **CLAIM:** Democratic presidential candidate Joe Biden said if your 8-year-old child wants to be transgender to make life easier, “they have a right to transition and there is no reason for you to deny it.”

Social media users shared an edited quote distorting his words to say: “If your 8 year old child says they want to be transgender to make life easier … they have a right to transition and there is no reason for you to deny it.”

Biden has outlined a series of policy goals related to the LGBTQ community on his website. Among them, he pledges to protect LGBTQ youth from civil rights violations and harassment in schools.

He has also said he would reverse a ban on transgender people serving in the military introduced under President Donald Trump. Biden’s website does not discuss sex changing medical procedures for children.
